newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Jan 9.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Thursday:
- U.S. Supreme Court justices reveal their reluctance to intercede in the issue of assisted suicide.

- Madeleine Albright, President Bill Clinton's secretary of state nominee, is given gentle treatment during confirmation hearings before the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, indicating rapid and smooth approval.
- European immigration to New York City surging in the 1990s.
- The government of President Slobodan Milosevic acknowledges that opposition parties have won control of Serbia's second largest city.
- The most fundamental health challenge in the world at the end of the 20th Century may be the same as it apparently was four millenniums ago -- sanitation and safe drinking water.
- For the first time, presidential inaugural memorabilia is available to a national audience, on the QVC cable shopping network.
